description: Zones du cadre réglementaire des réseaux FTTH - Pyrénées Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Open-Data La Fibre64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by La Fibre 64. Pour une partie des locaux des zones moins denses, des opérateurs privés ont manifesté depuis 2011 des intentions de déploiement de réseaux de boucle locale optique mutualisée ou commencé à déployer ces réseaux: ils forment ainsi les zones moins denses d'initiative privée. Le reste du territoire constitue par complément les zones moins denses d'initiative publique. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Aménagement numérique. Its keywords are FTTH, Fibre, Très haut débit, Télécom. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2020-03-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lafibre64-fr-portal.
